setup_distributed_process_group: setup a PyTorch distributed process group for multi-node SLURM or local multi-GPU training
cleanup_distributed_resources: cleanup and destroy the distributed process group and release GPU ports
all_reduce_tensors: perform an all-reduce operation on tensors across all processes with optional averaging
all_gather_tensors: gather tensors from all processes into a list on each process
broadcast_tensors: broadcast a tensor from a source rank to all other processes in the group
